visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a hand holding a smartphone, capturing a reflection of a woman with short black hair and a red lace top in a circular mirror overlay. She is sitting in an indoor office environment with soft indoor lighting. (2) The scene cuts to the woman at her desk, applying makeup with a large brush while holding a Coca-Cola bottle. A colleague in a black Nike cap sits behind her. (3) The woman stands beside a female colleague with long dark hair who is typing on a laptop. She points to the screen and holds a Coca-Cola bottle with a custom label 'Joanne'. (4) The woman approaches another colleague at a desk, showing her a 'Joyce' labeled bottle. She retrieves a small white digital camera from a red bear-themed plush pouch. (5) Transition to an outdoor rooftop setting during a clear sunny day. The woman holds a 'Justin' labeled bottle in front of a white bench covered in Coca-Cola merchandise, including a red bag, camera, and multiple bottles. (6) She is seen in an outdoor walkway between buildings, holding two Coca-Cola bottles and smiling at the camera. (7) The woman walks across a city crosswalk holding two 1.25L Coca-Cola bottles, wearing white lace pants. (8) A series of close-up shots show a yellow bottle cap with a QR code, followed by a hand using a smartphone to scan a QR code on a box of mini-cans. (9) The smartphone screen displays the 'Coke+' app interface showing points and rewards. (10) Back on the rooftop, the woman holds up two bottles and the rewards, speaking enthusiastically with a wide smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-pitched female dialogue in a casual, conversational tone. A playful, mid-tempo BGM with bright synth chords and a steady drum machine beat starts immediately. (2) A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the reveal of the first pun. The vocal arousal increases as the main narrator transitions into a promotional pitch. (3) Background keyboard clicking sounds are audible during the office scene. The music maintains a constant, energetic presence. (4) Distinct digital 'pop' and 'whoosh' sounds accompany the scene transitions and text pop-ups. (5) A clear digital chime sounds when the smartphone scans the QR code. (6) The narrator's speech rate increases in the second half of the video as she lists specific instructions and reward details, delivered with high clarity and enthusiastic rising intonations. (7) The BGM swells slightly in volume during the final call to action, ending on a bright, resolved synth note.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Examples of use -> Promotional Explanation -> Instruction -> Rewards -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a series of puns based on English names printed on Coca-Cola bottles to create a humorous hook, subsequently explaining a promotional campaign where consumers can collect words/characters by scanning QR codes on various Coke products to win branded merchandise like cameras and pouches.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is a direct promotional advertisement for a Coca-Cola campaign, featuring specific product labels, an app, and branded rewards.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy promotional content utilizing puns and social-media style editing to engage a younger audience in a points-collection event.
